item_name: Rothco Leather Clip-On Badge Holder with Swivel Snap
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Leather Clip-On Badge Holder with Swivel Snap provides an efficient and professional way for law enforcement and public safety personnel to mount and remove their badges on uniforms. Measuring 3 5/8 inches by 2 5/8 inches, this holder accommodates most standard shield badges. It features a snap closure with a robust iron clip, ensuring secure attachment to your uniform. The holder is designed with generic pin-in holes, allowing for easy and secure badge placement. Please Note: Badge Not Included.
description: Rothco’s Leather Clip-On Badge Holder with Swivel Snap provides an efficient and professional way for law enforcement and public safety personnel to mount and remove their badges on uniforms. Measuring 3 5/8 inches by 2 5/8 inches, this holder accommodates most standard shield badges. It features a snap closure with a robust iron clip, ensuring secure attachment to your uniform.
